Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Kestrel evaluation roadmap + commercial ask

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Kestrel was impressed by the latency and controls you showed. We want to move quickly on the evaluation plan so we can decide before our board meeting on August 15th.

High-level ask: we are prepared to sign a 12-month commitment if Redwood will extend a milestone-based discount tied to the evaluation MAP we discussed. Specifically: 20% off list for the first 6 months if we hit the evaluation KPIs (latency < 200ms P95 on our test set, uptime > 99.5% during pilot traffic) and then revert to a standard tiered price thereafter.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can commit to milestone-based pricing like this? If so, what approvals are required on your side and how fast can we get a signed agreement?

I've attached the internal evaluation plan summary for reference (Kestrel_Eval_Summary.pdf).

Best,
Amir
Head of ML Ops, Kestrel Analytics

Grace / team —

Thanks for flagging. A couple of quick thoughts from finance:
1) 20% off list for the first six months on a $1.2M ARR commit equates to roughly $120k in gross revenue deferral and material margin impact in Q3. We need contingencies in the agreement to protect Redwood if KPIs are not met (prorated refunds, clawbacks, or explicit failure criteria).
2) For commercial discounts: we can approve up to 15% at the commercial manager level. Anything above 15% needs VP sign-off; above 17.5% needs CFO/CEO review because it materially affects guidance.
3) Recommend structure: 12% effective discount + milestone-based rebate (up to additional 6% paid out after KPIs verified). This preserves cash recognition and lets us avoid significant upfront revenue concessions.

If the customer absolutely requires an upfront stacked 20% we should escalate to Aditya and present the strategic rationale. Otherwise, the rebate approach is safer.

-Ben
Director, Revenue Finance — Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Kestrel evaluation roadmap + discount request — need quick approval

Team —

I appreciate the fast turnaround. Kestrel looks like a strategically valuable pilot (retail partner opens a wider GTM). I'm comfortable recommending a commercial package that lands at ~18% total value to the customer, provided we:
- Make the material portion a post-verification rebate tied to the MAP milestones (documented verification step), and
- Require a minimum $1.2M ARR commitment and a co-sell introduction to their retail partner within 60 days of signing.

If Ben confirms accounting will allow the rebate to be recognized upon verification (with clear clawback language), I'll escalate to Aditya for final approval since 18% is above the commercial manager cap. Marissa, please prepare a clean DocuSign-ready agreement (no unusual T&Cs) and include the milestone metrics and verification process in the SOW.

-Lauren
VP Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 12:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Kestrel evaluation roadmap + discount request — need quick approval

Thanks — I agree with Lauren's recommendation but with conditions:
- Approve up to 18% total customer value, structured as 12% upfront discount + up to 6% milestone rebate paid after verification.
- This approval is conditional on (a) minimum $1.2M ARR commitment and (b) explicit success metrics documented in the MAP with a third-party verification step (or joint verification by Redwood and Kestrel).
- Add a failure clause: if KPIs are not met within the 6-week eval, customer reverts to standard pricing and any rebate is void; if customer cancels early we retain a pro-rated fee.

Marissa — once you have the DocuSign assembled with those clauses, send to procurement@kestrel.ai and cc me. Grace — deliver the updated MAP with verification language. We should aim to have signatures by Aug 9 to leave a buffer for integration planning.

-Aditya
CEO — Redwood Inference

- Commitment: 12-month term targeting $1.2M ARR (baseline).
- Commercial: 12% initial discount applied at signing, plus up to 6% milestone rebate (total customer value up to 18%) paid after verification of KPIs.

- Governance: Co-sell intro to Kestrel's retail partner within 60 days is required to unlock the rebate tranche; documentation to be included in the SOW.

Next steps for signatures: Marissa will send the DocuSign with the SOW and MAP (link below). Please review and confirm by Aug 9 so we can target signature and onboarding the week of Aug 12.

DocuSign (draft): https://docusign.com/request/KST-457-draft

Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk the verification process before the board meeting.
